Founded by serial travel-tech entrepreneurs and backed by Highgate Technology Ventures (HTV), we’re building the next generation of hotel distribution—automated, scalable, and integrated directly with CRS/PMS systems. Scale that speaks for itself: • 1B+ search requests per day • 40ms average response time • 200M+ inbound messages daily • Live integrations with Hilton, Highgate, Wyndham — rapidly expanding across the US and Europe We’re a remote-first, high-growth company with a strong engineering culture. Over the past 18 months, we've tripled our team, achieved 100% year-over-year revenue growth, and continue to scale rapidly—with real revenue traction and a growing global footprint. Our focus remains on automation and low-latency infrastructure to power real-time connectivity at scale. Tech Stack Frontend: React.js, TypeScript, Next.js, React Native, Redux, GraphQL, Tailwind CSS Backend & Infra: Java (Spring Boot), Microservices, AWS ECS, Redis, ScyllaDB, MongoDB, GraphQL, AWS Lambda, MySQL, Aurora Event Driven & AI: SQS, Kinesis, Claude, Cursor, LangChain Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Sentry Engineering Excellence: JVM tuning, GC profiling, Circuit Breakers, Async Tracing Role : Senior Full Stack Engineer (Java / Microservices) Location: Remote (Work from Home) We’re hiring an experienced Full Stack Engineer (React + Java) with 6–10 years of experience to design, build, and scale real-time web applications for our global B2B hotel marketplace. You’ll work across the stack—from building intuitive, data-driven UIs to high-performance backend services that power our distribution engine. Responsibilities ● Build and maintain end-to-end features spanning React.js frontends and Java (Spring Boot) microservices and database integrations . ● Develop responsive, performant, and accessible UIs integrated with REST and GraphQL APIs. ● Design and scale low-latency, high-throughput microservices for real-time data workflows. ● Implement event-driven systems using Kafka or SQS for asynchronous communication. ● Collaborate closely with Product, Design, and Architecture teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. ● Optimize application performance via caching strategies, async processing, and database tuning. ● Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines, test automation, and monitoring frameworks. ● Leverage AI-assisted tools (Claude, Cursor, etc.) to boost velocity and maintain code quality. ● Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and architecture decisions. ● Write clean, maintainable code, follow design patterns, maintain high test coverage, and document key technical decisions. Requirements ● 6–10 years of full stack development experience with a proven track record in production systems. ● Strong proficiency in React.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, Redux (or similar state management) and modern frontend frameworks. ● Solid backend experience with Java, Spring Boot, and Hibernate. ● Database experience with MySQL, MongoDB, or ScyllaDB. ● Hands-on with microservices, AWS (ECS/Lambda), SQS, and GraphQL. ● Familiarity with event-driven architectures and caching layers (Redis) and asynchronous processing. ● Working knowledge of observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, CloudWatch, Sentry). ● Understanding of data structures, algorithms, and system design fundamentals. ● Passion for clean code, testability, and engineering excellence. ● Strong analytical and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across Product, Design, and QA teams. ● Comfortable in a remote-first, asynchronous, and ownership-driven culture. Nice to Have ● Experience with React Native or mobile web frameworks. ● Exposure to Kafka, Kinesis, or other event-streaming platforms. ● Familiarity with CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Docker) and container orchestration (ECS). ● Experience with AI-assisted development, LLMs, or LangChain pipelines. ● Domain exposure to B2B platforms, travel-tech, or high-scale marketplaces. ● Background in Test-Driven Development (TDD) or Agile methodologies. Why Join Us? ● Work on mission-critical, high-scale systems used by global hotel brands. ● Build real-time, low-latency products impacting millions of hotel transactions daily. ● Be part of a remote-first, AI-accelerated engineering culture that values autonomy and quality. ● Collaborate with senior engineers and architects solving complex distributed system challenges. ● Competitive compensation with equity participation and career growth opportunities. ● Learn and work with cutting-edge AI tools—from code generation to observability automation.

5785eac3e36ef73c.description:
We are a growth agency. We don't just track data - we act on it. We help ecommerce and SaaS clients increase revenue through rigorous A/B testing, UX research, and conversion optimization. 

Key Responsibilities

A. Client Relationship and Strategic Partnership
1. Serve as the primary day-to-day contact for assigned clients and build trust by demonstrating a deep understanding of their business, industry, and goals.
2. Lead weekly client meetings by setting agendas, driving discussions, capturing action items, and ensuring clients feel confident and heard.
3. Translate client business goals, such as increasing revenue per visitor, into clear testing hypotheses and roadmap items.
4. Proactively address client concerns and manage expectations around timelines, results, and scope.

B. Experiment Lifecycle and Project Execution
1. Write detailed test plans covering the hypothesis, audience, variant design, success metrics, and test duration for each experiment.
2. Manage and prioritize the testing queue based on potential impact using the ICE Framework, client goals, and development capacity.
3. Coordinate test setup by bridging the gap between client requirements and development-team execution.
4. Ensure designers and developers have clear requirements and deliverables for each test.

C. QA Ownership
1. Coordinate the QA process to ensure tests render correctly across devices and goals are tracked accurately.
2. Monitor live tests, review results data, identify anomalies, and collaborate with the CRO team on analysis.

D. Internal Leadership and Process
1. Lead sprint planning to align design, development, and research teams on weekly priorities.
2. Facilitate seamless communication between cross-functional stakeholders and ensure timely execution of deliverables.
3. Identify workflow bottlenecks and implement process improvements.
4. Monitor development-hour utilization against project scope and escalate potential overages early.

E. Research and Strategy
1. Collaborate with the CRO team to develop growth strategies for clients.
2. Set up tools and processes for collecting quantitative research data through GA4 and analytics platforms.
3. Set up tools and processes for collecting qualitative research data through heatmaps, surveys, and other methods.
4. Assist in creating client-facing presentations that clearly communicate learnings and recommend future tests.
5. Contribute to testing roadmaps and prioritization by balancing quick wins with longer-term strategic initiatives.

Core Ownership:

1. Test Queue Management: Own the prioritization and flow of all client tests. 
2. Full Experiment Lifecycle: Take tests from hypothesis to launch to analysis. You ensure coordination and delivery at every stage.
3. Client Relationship (Primary Contact): Be the client's day-to-day partner. You lead the weekly calls, present results, and advise on what to test next.
4. Sprint Planning: Run weekly and monthly planning sessions to ensure the team is focused on high-impact activities.
5. Onboarding New Clients: Lead the 0-to-1 process, setting the tone for a smooth, confident partnership.
6. QA Coordination: Ensure every test renders perfectly and tracks correctly before it goes live.
7. Scope and Budget Vigilance: Monitor scope of work and development hours to ensure we deliver value profitably.
8. Cross-Functional Leadership: Be the glue between UX designers, developers, analysts, and clients.

Note:

1.
